name: Saeta International Sports Wear S.A.S.
note: Private Colombian sportswear manufacturer founded in Bogotá in 1982 by Pedro Aníbal Carrero (saetasport.com: 'Saeta Sport nació en 1982'; las2orillas.co, 19 June 2026: still a private Colombian company with the legal name Saeta International Sports Wear S.A.S. and Carrero family members in strategic roles; Infobae, 20 June 2026: Carrero is 'fundador y propietario' of the Saeta brand).
